description: OSM node 13342286294 on the DN54 at Deveselu; no sub-variant and no tactical number recorded

Single-seat pre-series 1 airframe; left the factory 27 Feb 1981; the iar93.ro register places it at Deveselu but gives no coordinate so whether it stands with the MiG-21 or inside the base is unverified; year_built from the published factory roll-out date
